Name: Sony CrSDK Camera Plugin for N.I.N.A.
Author: isky

Descriptions.ShortDescription: Sony CrSDK 相机接入与共享控制 / Sony CrSDK camera integration and shared controls.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
## 中文

通过 Sony Camera Remote SDK，在 N.I.N.A. 中使用 Sony 相机。支持普通曝光、软件 Bulb、ISO/快门控制、JPEG 实时预览及 Bayer RAW 解码；Sony 扩展控制面板与标准相机入口共享连接。

**环境与兼容性**：Windows x64、N.I.N.A. 3.2.0.9001、Microsoft VC++ v14 x64 运行库。实机验证机型为 Sony A7 V（ILCE-7M5，固件 2.00）；其他机型需分别验证。

**安装**：请自行取得并解压 Sony Camera Remote SDK 2.02.00 Windows x64。插件安装并重启 NINA 后，会查找并配置匹配的 SDK；未找到时选择一次 SDK 目录。自动查找有范围限制，自定义深层目录可能需要手动选择。写入受保护的共享适配器目录时，Windows 会请求管理员授权。公开包不包含 Sony SDK，也不安装驱动或运行库；SDK 配置不会连接相机。个人设置和 SDK 缓存独立保存，插件升级时保留。

[安装、升级与卸载](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.5/docs/INSTALL.md) · [使用说明](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.5/docs/USAGE.md) · [兼容性](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.5/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)

独立社区项目，与 Sony 或 N.I.N.A. 官方无隶属关系。项目实质性使用了 AI 辅助开发，由 isky 维护。

---

## English

Use Sony cameras in N.I.N.A. through Sony Camera Remote SDK. Features include normal exposures, software Bulb, ISO/shutter control, JPEG LiveView and Bayer RAW decoding. The Sony control panel and standard camera interface share one connection.

**Requirements and compatibility**: Windows x64, N.I.N.A. 3.2.0.9001 and Microsoft VC++ v14 x64 runtime. Sony A7 V (ILCE-7M5, firmware 2.00) is the hardware-verified model; other models require separate validation.

**Installation**: Obtain and extract Sony Camera Remote SDK 2.02.00 Windows x64 yourself. After plugin installation and a N.I.N.A. restart, the plugin searches for and configures a matching SDK. If none is found, select its directory once. Discovery is bounded; custom deeply nested locations may need manual selection. Windows administrator consent may be required to write protected shared-adapter directories. No Sony SDK is bundled, and the plugin does not install drivers or system runtimes. SDK setup does not connect to a camera. User preferences and SDK caches are stored separately and preserved across plugin updates.

[Installation, upgrade and removal](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.5/docs/INSTALL.md) · [Usage](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.5/docs/USAGE.md) · [Compatibility](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.5/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)

An independent community project, not affiliated with Sony or N.I.N.A. Developed with substantial AI assistance and maintained by isky.
